2_independent_reader.what: a separate DST parser (pyembroidery) read the file and its stitch count was compared

3_physical_machine.how_to_change: Stitch the test pack on your machine and record the result; this software cannot do it.

limits: This report does not predict stitch-out quality and does not guarantee the absence of thread breaks, puckering or registration errors.
